item.title: Continuous femoral nerve block not superior to adductor canal block for ACL pain
item.description: A study found no advantage of continuous femoral nerve block over adductor canal block for average postoperative pain after ACL reconstruction.

item.title: 2 Minute Medicine Rewind for September 7, 2026
item.description: Highlights include a study linking higher maternal BMI and gestational weight gain to cardiovascular disease in offspring.

item.title: Small bowel microbiome may influence women's health
item.description: Cedars-Sinai researchers found differences in small bowel microbiome composition and organization that could affect women's health.

item.title: Skin involvement seen in 1 in 5 bacteremia patients
item.description: A study suggests skin involvement is common in neutropenic patients with Pseudomonas aeruginosa bloodstream infections.
